summary: No new trust boundary, input, dependency, secret or randomness (matches spec §8). Checked the open timeout for data loss and connection leaks in src/storage/hand-store.ts opened(): every event handler clears the timer; giveUp is idempotent (settle !== null guard), so a timeout followed by a late onblocked does not double-reject or replace the settle promise. onupgradeneeded clears the timer, so a timeout can never fire while an upgrade is in progress, and a late upgrade after a timeout still runs the same oldVersion-gated, additive migrations (no store deleted or cleared). A late onsuccess after the timeout closes the connection and settles blockedOpen, so there is no stray connection holding the DB or blocking future upgrades; a late onerror also settles. Removing the `db === opening` guard is safe: db is only assigned while null, so it still equals `opening` when that promise rejects. Leaving blockedOpen as an already-settled promise is harmless: the race resolves true on the next microtask. e2e/support/hold-writes.ts is a test-only init script and is not imported by the bundle. No findings.
